|translation='''Title:''' Obi-Wan Kenobi.

'''Card text:''' If he has been participating from the start of the battle, use 1 Force to choose one opponent's character of ability = 1. Force that character to move with no move cost. If that character does not move, place it in the Lost Pile. Immune to attrition < 5.

'''Lore:''' Jedi Knight. Received Yoda's teaching. Friend of Bail Organa. General Kenobi became a hero of the Old Republic's army during the Clone Wars. Mentor of Anakin and Luke Skywalker.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore names Anakin and Luke as his pupils; the English lore names Luke. The Japanese game text triggers if he has been participating from the start of the battle; the English triggers if you initiated the battle.
|notes='''Obi-Wan Kenobi (Japanese Reflections III Foil)''' is a Japanese-language foil printing of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. [[Decipher]] released it in [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]] in October 2001. The ordinary Japanese expansion printing is [[Obi-Wan Kenobi (Japanese)]]. Complete Card List v4 lists checklist R64 at rarity SR. Collector R-numbers are checklist references, not GEMP blueprint IDs.<ref name="checklist">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Complete Card List v4.0], p. 31, Reflections III foil cards, R64.
